title: Bringing AI to Autonomous Systems -- From Cognition to Collective Intelligence
description:
arXiv:2609.30291v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The purpose of this article is to highlight the central role of autonomous systems as the ultimate stage in the development of AI, to explain the underlying technical challenges that require a combination of connectionist AI and symbolic AI, and to integrate AI and systems engineering.
